verdict.rationale: Openness of source code is a fair question for a SaaS card-issuing API, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Stripe Issuing's source is published under an open license. The docs, llms.txt, MCP server and CLI probes describe API access and tooling, not open-source availability of the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
